# 鞘翅紋飾擴展 *覺得原版紋飾不夠看？或是你最愛的模組新增了更多盔甲紋飾，卻沒有支援鞘翅？ 鞘翅紋飾擴展來拯救你啦！*
# 安裝方式 請先在客戶端安裝主模組([鞘翅紋飾](https://modrinth.com/mod/elytra-trims))。額外的紋飾將會自動添加。 # 支援模組 ## [更多盔甲紋飾](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-armor-trims) (Fabric) ![MAT #1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5edtQ4at/images/a14a4a8064a83654e28aa4fe363154df7bf6c5d5.png) ![MAT #2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5edtQ4at/images/9e5e1ecde0fa793bf9b79d7babe8849d0052e0d1.png) ![MAT #3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5edtQ4at/images/1ea603724a77fa24b0b12c45d1703b1382da9b9b.png)
## [遠古天際](https://modrinth.com/mod/ancient-aether) (Forge) ![AA #1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5edtQ4at/images/28a1dfedb6c8de817db8dd33807d5ddc3a4d661f.png) ![AA #2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5edtQ4at/images/83d1eedaf6d66d514b570bab0423fb5bc248e156.png) ![AA #3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5edtQ4at/images/aa7ea20d9a5f544069cd1cab113d2ab10b0e1716.png)
## [晶洞+](https://modrinth.com/mod/geode-plus) (Fabric & Forge) ![晶洞+](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5edtQ4at/images/ebf229dc9ad8252384e5c12864500510c3e67d95.png)
## [霜雪奇緣](https://modrinth.com/mod/frostiful) (Fabric) ![霜雪奇緣](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5edtQ4at/images/36eec29b7e833b958fb31099db8871a305fe68d8.png)
## [亞歷克斯洞穴](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves) (Forge) ![AC](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5edtQ4at/images/14fe7e56d92683cd77f9f5401db8894698b1d444.png)
## [更多嗅探花](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-sniffer-flowers) (Forge) ![MSF](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5edtQ4at/images/b673ff8837f5cd36b8988acf0fb8f8798cf937fc.png) # 支援本模組 如果你知道其他新增紋飾圖案的模組或資料包，歡迎透過GitHub問題回報或Discord伺服器私訊告訴我！
